caption: The drawing depicts an apron with a brownish base color. The apron features two hexagonal pockets positioned symmetrically on either side of the center, each pocket decorated with embroidered red flowers, green leaves, and clusters of small purple grapes. The bottom edge and sides of the apron are scalloped and outlined with a green wavy border, dotted with small purple spots along the edge. The main body of the apron includes additional embroidered floral motifs along the lower portion, with larger red and purple flowers, green leaves, red buds, and more bunches of purple grapes, all concentrated near the hem and corners. The apron is tied with two straps extending from the waistband at the top. The entire composition is rendered in detailed, realistic shading to give a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Sewing Apron
